{{Quote|He's trying to destroy my flagship! He wants to humiliate me.|[[Lord High Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], about [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
The '''Battle of Harrsk's fortress''' was a skirmish in the [[Imperial Civil War]].

==Background==
{{Quote|We've detected incoming ships, moving fast. More of the out-system spy holocams triggered alarms, a dozen more ships coming from below the orbital plane this time. I've spotted seventy.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kratas]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
[[File:Daala3.jpg|thumb|left|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]].]]

Upon learning that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] would be visiting the world of his nemesis, [[Warlord/Legends|Supreme Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] sent his [[Crimson Command]] on a mission to humiliate Harrsk.

==The battle==
{{Quote|We can't hold out much longer. Shields failing. Admiral, I...|Kratas' last words, to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
Just as Harrsk was showing off his assembled fleet of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] to Daala, the [[Crimson Command]] force arrived in-system under the command of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], with orders to destroy Harrsk's prized [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Shockwave (Imperial-class)|''Shockwave'']].

[[File:GiladPellaeon.jpg|thumb|right|140px|[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]].]]

[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kratas]], Daala's second-in-command, was touring the ''Shockwave'' and assumed command of the counterattack. Concentrating firepower on the large ship, Pellaeon's forces managed to overpower its shields and destroy it, damaging three other ships at the cost of eleven of their own.

{{Quote|Oh Kratas, I'm sorry.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] upon Kratas's death|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have no intention of assisting you in your childish brawl, Warlord Harrsk. You just lost me the best commander I ever had. I will not perpetuate this.''"<br />"''Stormtroopers! [sic] Take Admiral Daala to one of my Star Destroyers. She will command our retaliatory strike against High Admiral Teradoc. If she refuses, you will execute her immediately for treason.|Admiral Daala and Warlord Harrsk|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
In response, Harrsk forced Admiral Daala into his service, and the two took the remaining eight star destroyers to Teradoc's sphere of influence but the [[Battle of Teradoc's fortress|strike]] was prematurely stopped by the intervention of Daala. This led to the series of events which culminated in the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] meeting at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] and the unification of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under Admiral Daala and Vice Admiral Pellaeon.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identified Harrsk's capital world as [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist]].
